thread:
incbot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT OPENED — per-tenant observability gap for customer rivermark-prod (dedicated pool). Missing traces and tail logs for tenant_id=rvk-prod. Paging oncall.

oncall-bot: Paging @oncall (primary) — please ack in channel. Severity: P2 until more info.

olivia (cs): acked. Customer reporting 502s from model endpoint and no trace ids in their dashboard. They can see tokens consumed but cannot correlate requests to traces. Highly visible for a payment flow.

sam (eng-sre): @mike any recent forwarder/partitioning deploys to dedicated pools?

mike (eng-platform): rolled an ingress-forwarder change 18m ago to add tenant-shard routing optimization. Config revert-hover in progress. Suspect routing rule dropped rvk-prod from trace-forwarder mapping.

lena (support): Customer impact: ~10% of requests intermittently missing spans, errors correlate to 20:14-20:28 UTC window. They opened a support ticket (INC-6542) and asked for ETA.

arek (dedicated-ops): I can attach to the pool and check forwarder logs. Pulling logs now. Using:

```bash
# tail logs for tenant routing
kubectl -n dedicated-forwarders logs -l pool=rvk-pool --since=30m | grep "tenant=rvk-prod" -A5 -B5
```

sam (eng-sre): If routing lost tenant header we might see spans emitted to default shard. Also check redis/kvs mapping TTLs — a stale mapping could evict tenant routing.

arek (dedicated-ops): quick scan: routing table shows no entry for rvk-prod on forwarder-2. forwarder-1 has entries. forwarder-2 restarted ~19m ago. Getting restart logs.

incbot: Note: recent maintenance window flag was set for dedicated pool rvk-pool at 19:00 UTC by platform-autoupdater.

mike (eng-platform): That matches the deployment. The rollout included a traffic-routing delta that accidentally filtered out tenants with metadata key legacy:true. Is rvk-prod tagged with that?

olivia (cs): Yes — they have legacy:true set from onboarding.

sam (eng-sre): Ok root cause likely routing filter + single forwarder restart causing partitioned visibility. Mitigation options: 1) patch forwarder to include legacy tenants immediately, 2) manually rehydrate routing table for rvk-prod on forwarder-2, or 3) fail traffic to a healthy forwarder via LB weight swap.

arek (dedicated-ops): I can patch routing table live, low blast. Steps: exec into forwarder-2 and run add-tenant script.

```bash
kubectl -n dedicated-forwarders exec -it forwarder-2 -- /usr/local/bin/add-tenant.sh --tenant rvk-prod --shard forwarder-1
```

sam (eng-sre): Before manual patch, confirm spans emitted and indexes appear in tracing store. If not, we need to replay buffered events from forwarder-2 (if persisted).

arek (dedicated-ops): Patched routing table. add-tenant returned 0. Observability: starting to see span ids stream in.

lena (support): Customer confirms traces reappearing in their console — partial recovery. They still see gaps for the 20:10-20:20 window.

kev in (customer-risk): spelling correction: kevin (customer-risk) here — major note: this customer handles transactions; recommend extended monitoring and SLO grace window, loop in account exec.

mike (eng-platform): I'll push a hotfix to the ingress-forwarder to prevent filtering legacy:true. Hotfix branch: hotfix/ingress-backfill-legacy. Rolling to remaining forwarders now.

sam (eng-sre): Also schedule a data-replay job for buffered spans from forwarder-2 to fill missing windows. We have a replay tool.

```bash
# replay spans from local buffer (forwarder-2) to trace-ingest
/replay-tool --source forwarder-2 --tenant rvk-prod --from 2024-05-17T20:10:00Z --to 2024-05-17T20:20:00Z
```

arek (dedicated-ops): Replay kicked off. ETA ~6m for backfill due to rate-limits. Monitoring.

olivia (cs): Customer acknowledges mitigation, wants postmortem and assurance this won't recur. They've asked for timeline on permanent fix.

mike (eng-platform): Permanent fix: remove legacy filter and add unit tests + canary to detect tenant dropouts. Hoping to merge and deploy within 3h, can expedite if needed.

sam (eng-sre): Action items:
- sam: validate replay completes and verify span continuity in customer console.
- mike: merge hotfix, deploy to all forwarders, add e2e test.
- arek: capture forwarder-2 restart cause and add stronger healthchecks.
- olivia/lena: update customer every 10m until fully recovered.

incbot: Incident severity updated to P1 (customer-impacting) while backfill running. Assigned runbook: per-tenant-obsv-gap.

lena (support): Update: replay finished, gaps backfilled. Customer confirms traces for 20:10–20:20 present. They reported no further 502s after routing patch.

olivia (cs): Customer happy with immediate fix, requested postmortem and timeline for preventive work. Passing to eng for follow-up.

sam (eng-sre): Closing live mitigation. We'll keep the incident open for postmortem. Tagging dedicated-ops for root cause analysis.

mike (eng-platform): Noted. I'll include rollout checklist changes and add a preflight check that validates tenant routing keys post-deploy.

incbot: INCIDENT UPDATED — status: mitigation-complete. Duration: 00:40.

kevin (customer-risk): Good job team. Recommend follow-up meeting with Rivermark execs and SRE to present fixes.

olivia (cs): scheduling next-week postmortem with customer.

sam (eng-sre): Adding notes to incident tracker INC-6542. Postmortem owner: sam. Timeline and remediation to be posted in 48h.

incbot: This thread will be archived when postmortem is attached. :thumbsup:
